description: This file defines options and utility functions for configuring the TensorPipe RPC backend in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework, including device mapping and initialization parameters.

classes.name: TensorPipeRpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Class for configuring TensorPipe RPC backend options, including device mappings, thread count, and timeouts.

methods.name: _to_device
methods.description: Converts a device specification to a torch.device object, ensuring it is a CUDA device.

methods.name: _to_device_map
methods.description: Creates a full device mapping dictionary with 1-to-1 device mappings, raising an error on conflicts.

methods.name: _to_device_list
methods.description: Converts a list of device specifications to a list of torch.device objects.

methods.name: set_device_map
methods.description: Sets device mapping between caller and callee workers, supporting multiple calls for incremental configuration.

methods.name: set_devices
methods.description: Sets local CUDA devices used by the RPC agent, ensuring proper CUDA stream synchronization.
